payload.friendly_name: Context-lean steering: kernel + capsule + gates over the spec-kitty engine
payload.purpose_context: Deliver an upstream-friendly lean steering layer over the existing engine: a tiny standing kernel, a bounded per-step capsule, and machine gates, plus a driver that tolerates batched tool calls. Proven on consumer-hardware models (9B Q4) in the spike; the mission productionises it and resolves the requires-inline ADR tension.
payload.purpose_tldr: Cut per-turn steering context ~100x while keeping the engine and its gates
